text: 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平近日就发展先进制造业作出重要指示指出，党的十八大以来，我国先进制造业不断发展壮大，创新力、竞争力、综合实力显著增强，制造强国建设迈出坚实步伐。习近平强调，新征程上，要以新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，统筹高质量发展和高水平安全，坚持智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，持续做大做强先进制造业，提升产业链自主可控水平，加快构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系，巩固壮大实体经济根基，为推进中国式现代化提供有力支撑。（新华社）
text_en: Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the People's Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, recently issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, stating that since the 18th CPC National Congress, China's advanced manufacturing has continued to develop and grow, with innovation capability, competitiveness, and overall strength significantly enhanced, and solid strides made in building a manufacturing powerhouse. Xi Jinping emphasized that on the new journey, it is necessary to be guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully and accurately implement the new development philosophy, coordinate high-quality development and high-level security, adhere to the direction of intelligent, green, and integrated development, continuously expand and strengthen advanced manufacturing, enhance the level of independent and controllable industrial chains, accelerate the construction of a modern industrial system with advanced manufacturing as the backbone, consolidate and strengthen the foundation of the real economy, and provide strong support for advancing Chinese-style modernization. (Xinhua News Agency)
